profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments | Ex-Microsoft

positions.title: Research Assistant - TxBDC Lab
positions.description:
Perform Surgery, Histology, Construction,  Motor Mapping, and Suturing in TxBDC neuro-engineering Lab.
The team works towards enhancing therapy and recovery following various brain, spinal cord, and peripheral nerve injuries through the use of Vagus Nerve Stimulation. 
Review and check code for implemented machinery during experiments.
Please review the paper attached for additional information.

positions.title: Supplemental Instruction Leader
positions.description:
Lead interactive and collaborative study sessions in previously completed classes I have excelled in. Currently an SI Leader for a course with 300+ students.
Facilitate active student learning in classes by leading study sessions, games, and activities in order to help students excel in their coursework. Regularly attend course and collaborate with instructors and Teaching Assistants to provide most relevant content.
Guide new SI Leaders by providing tools to effectively facilitate learning sessions and interact with students.

positions.title: Software Engineering Technical Intern - Personal Investment (CRM / Salesforce)
positions.description:
Developed a fully functioning application to enter Personal Investment's potential customer data, send it to a customer profile database where it completes de-duplication and enrichment tasks, and then route it to the Salesforce platform where it can be accessed by other PI associates. 

Worked in the Salesforce Developer Edition environment, with tools including Visualforce pages, Apex classes and static resources, HTML/CSS and Javascript front end development, Java development, and other Salesforce specific tools such as Web-To-Leads, Salesforce-Heroku integration, and Force.com sites.

Additional development tools: used REST APIs to consume web services, used CSS markups such as Bootstrap &  development using AngularJS and Node.js
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1st Place Prize Recipient of Fidelity Investments Voice-Enabled Hackathon.
o	Developed an internal Fidelity program to search and categorize employees and their information using the Amazon Echo and Alexa technology

projects.title: C++/ C#/ MATLAB Software Development UT Dallas NeuroEngineering Lab
projects.description:
